eng: Joint procurement office (FIK), hereafter called the contracting authority, invites tenderers to an open tender contest for the procurement of wholesaler goods, including frozen goods for Frogn, Nesodden, Vestby and Ås municipalities. The contracting authority intends to enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer for this sub-contract.

Joint procurement office (FIK), hereafter called the contracting authority, invites tenderers to an open tender competition for fruit and vegetables for frogn, Nesodden, Vestby and Ås municipalities. The contracting authority intends to enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer for this sub-contract.

Joint procurement office (FIK), hereafter called the contracting authority, invites tenderers to an open tender competition for the procurement of fresh meat products for Frogn, Nesodden, Vestby and Ås municipalities. The contracting authority intends to enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer for this sub-contract.

Joint procurement office (FIK), hereafter called the contracting authority, invites tenderers to an open tender competition for the procurement of birds, poultry and egg products for Frogn, Nesodden, Vestby and Ås municipalities. The contracting authority intends to enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer for this sub-contract.

Joint procurement office (FIK), hereafter called the contracting authority, invites tenderers to an open tender competition for bakery and confectionery for Frogn, Nesodden, Vestby and Ås municipalities. The contracting authority intends to enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer for this sub-contract.

Joint procurement office (FIK), hereafter called the contracting authority, invites tenderers to an open tender competition for the procurement of fresh fish for Frogn, Nesodden, Vestby and Ås municipalities. The contracting authority intends to enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer for this sub-contract.

Joint procurement office (FIK), hereafter called the contracting authority, invites tenderers to an open tender competition for the procurement of dairy products for frogn, Nesodden, Vestby and Ås. The contracting authority intends to enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer for this sub-contract. Note: This sub-contract will start 02.04.2025 as the existing contract for dairy products runs until 01.04.2025. The contract will be valid until 07.12.2028 as this will harmonise with the other sub-contracts in the competition.

The Joint Procurement Office (FIK), hereinafter referred to as the contracting authority, invites open tenders for the purchase and delivery of food for small orders to the municipalities of Frogn, Nesodden, Vestby, and Ås. The aim of the procurement is to cover the municipalities ́ need for a contract where they can shop and deliver food for small orders. The intention of the competition is that there are several smaller units in the municipalities that have a smaller need for food deliveries, where then the contracting authority wants a supplier who can deliver food across the other sub-contracts together. The contracting authority intends to enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer for this sub-contract.

description-proc.eng: The FIK municipalities (Frogn, Nesodden Vestby and Ås) currently have food and dairy agreements that expire in December 2024 (dairy 2 April 2025), and are now going out with a new tender competition with 8 sub-contracts: Sub-contract 1: "Wholesale goods, including frozen goods' Sub-contract 2: "Fruit and vegetables"Sub-contract 3: "Fresh meat products"Sub-contract 4: "Birds, poultry and egg products", Sub contract 5: "Bakery and confectionery"Lot 6:  'Fresh fish', Sub-contract 7: 'Dairy products', sub-contract 8: 'Small procurements'.
